notes.title: Update 1.09 is out now
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The festive season is upon us, and our team has been working hard to release this small, but important update for you to enjoy the game without any pesky bugs during this charming time of the year! 

We would also like to take this opportunity to celebrate the work of the localization teams, who have helped us bring the magical world of Asterigos to players' homes.

We at Acme Gamestudio are incredibly proud that we have been able to release a game that has resonated with players all over the world, and we couldn't have done it without the help of all the talented people involved in the localization processes. 

Thanks to them, you can enjoy the game (and read this news!) in 11 languages today. 

We want to thank each and every one of you! With this update, we have finally gathered and included a complete list of all the localization studios and specialists who worked on the game in the end credits to properly acknowledge your contributions.

[h2]List of changes in Patch 1.09[/h2]

[list]
 [*]Localisation teams have been added to the end credits.
 [*]Fixed some localization errors.
 [*]Fixed a bug that could cause Hilda's idle animation to glitch and not play correctly.
 [*]Fixed a bug that could cause the ""Adrenaline Rush"" talent to not function properly.
 [*]Fixed a bug that could cause the main storyline in the Glittering Deeps to not proceed correctly.
[/list]

[h2]Join our community[/h2]
Make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/MqErEDrf8Z]join the official Discord server[/url] to chat with fellow travellers, and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the news!

notes.title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars Anniversary Patch and Dev Q&A
notes.content:
It’s been a year since the gates to the City of Aphes opened to the brave explorers! We’d like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who has embarked on this adventure with us and shared their epic stories.

To celebrate this special milestone, we have prepared a lot of exciting things for you!

[h2]Patch 1.08 is now LIVE[/h2]
[h3]Introducing the new game mode: Gauntlet of the Stars.[/h3]
Return to the City of Aphes and be prepared to face the formidable foes of the past once again to win a unique reward!

This Boss Rush Mode is a gauntlet challenge that allows you to rematch the deadly bosses of Asterigos in an exhilarating series of battles. The reward for completing the first four series is the shining armour of [b]Gladiatrix Battlegear[/b], a new outfit that becomes account-wide once unlocked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/07acb29d4395aaa9a3181c397f51d1be07a0edfc.png[/img]

To access Gauntlet of the Stars, you will need to progress until you have defeated the final boss of the main story or anytime in NG+ once you can enter the Shelter. Interact with the Gryphon statue in the Shelter to open up the menu and select the challenge. 

There will be no death penalty if you are defeated in the Gauntlet. Additionally, you can bring any items or weapons into the series. So, fight dirty like a real gladiator, as the enemies show no mercy either.

[h3]Update 1.08 Patch Notes[/h3]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]New Boss Rush Mode: Gauntlet of the Stars[/b], accessible through the Gryphon statue in the Shelter after defeating the final boss.
[*] [b]New outfit[/b]: Gladiatrix Battlegear, obtainable by completing Gauntlet of the Stars.
[*] Praying at the Shrines in Call of the Paragons DLC will no longer trigger mob respawns.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to be unable to proceed during the encounter with Alkinoos and Philippos.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Brilliant Sun weapon mod would cause some perks to work incorrectly.
[/list]
[/expand]
[h2]Watch the Developer Q&A [/h2]
We have put together a special video in which we asked the Asterigos: Curse of the Stars development team the questions you sent us over the last week! Thank you for sending these over, it’s been great fun talking to the developers about the topics you mentioned! 

[previewyoutube=mwlExoM02-I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Anniversary Sale[/h2]
Save [b]up to 45%[/b] on [i]Asterigos: Curse of the Stars[/i] and DLCs [b]from October 11th till October 17th[/b]!

[*] Asterigos Curse of the Stars Deluxe Edition - 40% off
[*] Asterigos: Curse of the Stars Ultimate Edition - 35% off
[*] Digital Artbook - 45% off
[*] Digital Soundtrack - 45% off
[/list]

[h2]Celebrating the Asterigos Community[/h2]
We'd also like to celebrate the [i]Asterigos: Curse of the Stars[/i] community! Cosplayers, artists, virtual photographers, musicians, streamers and everyone - thank you so much for your love and support! Here's to you!

notes.title: Designing the Paragons
notes.content:
With the release of the [i][b]Asterigos: Call of the Paragons[/b][/i] expansion right around the corner, Hilda can step into Phantasma - a mysterious new realm full of danger and untold legends.

In today's devlog, we want to open up the mystery a bit and tell you about Phantasma and the challenges you will have to face.

[h2]The breathtaking Phantasma[/h2]
Phantasma is the realm of the Ascended Paragons, the heroes and heroines of Aphes' past who ascended and rested among the Gods of the Stars. We really wanted the area to resemble and be associated with myths and mystique of cosmic proportions.

Hence the color blue, the purple night sky, and the many interstellar phenomena, as if Hilda had stepped into an alien world where everything simultaneously looks so exotic and yet familiar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/9378e361def6a352974b15bf8169c563723d31a9.jpg[/img]

[h2]A realm full of stories[/h2]
When we were designing the world of Asterigos, we had many stories to tell. These include the struggle for the lives of the citizens of Aphes, the bravery of the Northwind Legion, and the story of the City of Stars. However, there are many stories we haven't had time to tell, especially the myths of Aphes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/13816bb74ac4fca1aa68e86d07d9a4008aef928f.jpg[/img]

So this time, with Phantasma as the central location for the DLC, we finally get to tell the story and build the adventure around it.

The challenges Hilda will face are those of the Paragons. These legendary heroes rested among the Gods for eons until their sleep was disturbed by an unknown dark force. When Hilda entered Phantasma, the paragons perceived the stranger as an intruder and thought she was the one behind unleashing the dark force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/e648d237777edc47e1a1ec785ccacee72ee7355d.png[/img]

Hilda must prove her innocence by passing the harshest trials of the Paragons, the one of which we are about to tell you.

[h2]Facing the Legendary Heroes of the Past[/h2]
One of the seven heroes Hilda will face is Hippocrates. Founder of the Phalan Academy. The tenth Archon of the Legion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/e43c39bb9e33e88990886faa99178e1fd3e536a1.png[/img]

Despite his noble origins, Hippocrates did not possess the arrogance and haughtiness inherent in other Aristoi. He was rude, impertinent, and unashamedly critical of his opponents. This character helped him get along with his peers in the legion in no time. 

Believing that warriors should be well-trained in combat, magic, and wisdom, Hippocrates quickly put his thoughts into practice after joining the legion. He endowed his shield with Starite magic and controlled the shield's levitation with magic, taking his enemies by surprise during battles. This was unheard of in those days for Aphes, and Hippocrates was the first warrior to use Starite magic in his battle weapons.

Seeking to encourage the use of Starite in weapons, Hippocrates even used his family's wealth and lands to conduct research and eventually developed various types of astral ballistas, which were considered very advanced at the time.

Some could release a continuous astral beam to trap or obstruct enemies' movement, but the beams trajectory could not be altered during use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/000ffd30576c436456de07aa298a15d933d29b59.png[/img]

Others could track enemies and destroy them in a matter of seconds, but their range was limited, and they used a much larger amount of Starite.

Due to the limitations of Starite magic technology, the design of astral ballistas was far from perfect, and they were expensive to make. While they could not be made widely available, they were still valuable research material for generations to come.

And though Hippocrates' tenure as the tenth Archon of the Legion was very short, he lived up to his credo and laid the cornerstone for the future of Aphes.

[h2]The Trials of Hippocrates[/h2]
For the Hippocrates challenge, the battle begins with the first phase, an endurance test. Many projectiles like laser beams will be aimed at Hilda, and shields of judgement will fall from the sky, all under the constant onslaught of Hippocrates' minions. Only when Hilda can defeat them can she come face to face with Hippocrates himself.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r5imZGs.gif[/img]

This is how the second phase begins - a strength test. Hippocrates has a floating magical shield that constantly surrounds him and blocks any incoming attacks. This gives him the advantage of being able to push through. And that makes Hippocrates a formidable foe.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BMb8gSi.gif[/img]

Try to figure out the right battle tactics and find his weaknesses!

[h2]Upgrade your weapons[/h2]
We have also introduced a new game system: Weapon Mods. It allows Hilda to further customize her weapons with strong and unique powers. For example, the Brilliant Sun Blades allow Hilda to deal extra damage with her dual blades at the cost of stamina, while the Sword and Shield of the Starry Sky unleash a magic blast with every shield attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/3b5551146c609a80794c70f0c8939602ee80136e.jpg[/img]

The new weapon mods can be unlocked by collecting rare materials from Phantasma and across the City of Aphes.

Vulcan will be happy to upgrade the weapons for you in the Shelter!

Make sure to join the official Discord server to chat with fellow travellers, and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the news!

notes.title: Update 1.06 Preview
notes.content:
Hello, Warriors of the Northwind Legion!

As we mentioned earlier, a new 1.06 update will be released alongside the [b]Call of the Paragons DLC[/b] later this month, and today we’d like to give you a preview of what to expect from this update.

The update 1.06 will be free and available to all players who own [b]Asterigos: Curse of the Stars[/b] on February 23rd, before the release of the DLC.



[h3]Gift of the Nexus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/63283b1fb1c0a6d7d5e31da14446f592ac171bd9.jpg[/img]

We wanted to make world exploration even more exciting and rewarding, so in the 1.06 update, a new system called [b]Gift of the Nexus[/b] is coming to the game.

You'll be able to find treasure chests scattered throughout the City of Aphes, with various improvements to Hilda's skills, stats, weapons, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/ee156aa8f96e71b676859bbdeda97fe806f470e3.jpg[/img]

As you open the chests, you'll fill up the progress bar. As you reach each level of Gift of the Nexus, a new reward will be waiting for you, so don't be afraid to peek around the corner during your adventures so you won't miss one of these chests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/6a905a8f6a70b9bcaffddbb2c88506e17a03b3dd.jpg[/img]

Your Glimmer has also learned some new tricks. It will now emit a small beam of light when one of the treasure chests is near you. This will hopefully make it a little easier for you to find them.


[h3]New Outfits[/h3]
In addition to permanent improvements to your attributes and armor, Gift of the Nexus also includes several new looks for Hilda. Both [b]Arcanic Phantom Mantle[/b] and [b]Armor of the Blue Meteor[/b] are available for free and will become account-wide when unlocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/8341a397f3f5dcc2a82c37c8c01f7484a2f91ea0.gif[/img]

[h3]Mark Stone[/h3]
You can now leave a colored mark according to your elemental enhancement on a location to help you with directions while exploring. The Mark Stone is visible from a distance and can also be removed remotely if needed. Get it from a new game or the War Table in the Shelter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/562749a232653b11ca38c07d72f9500c2a815ae5.gif[/img]


[h3]QOL Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new system option that automatically allows you to skip the re-spawn animation after death has been added.
[*] A new system option that enables a permanent dash after a dodge action has been added.
[*] A new system option that allows you to lock target selection has been added.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could cause some players to get stuck in combat in the Glittering Deeps.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Arges Plaza chapter in Journal to show incorrect page titles.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to still gain experience in certain situations when equipped with the Eye of the Abyss Amulet.
[/list]


[h1]Join our community[/h1]
Make sure to join the official Discord server to chat with fellow travellers, and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the news!

notes.title: Asterigos: Call of the Paragons DLC arrives February 23rd
notes.content:
The rifts to Phantasma have torn asunder, and Paragons are calling. Will you have the strength and courage to answer?

[h3]Asterigos: Call of the Paragons arrives February 23rd. [/h3]
Wishlist now to be among the first to enter the new Realm.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969900/Asterigos_Call_of_the_Paragons/ 

[h2]Watch the new trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=WJiTH5dM0aY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Challenges[/h2]
Get ready to put your skills to the test in a series of new challenges. 

Stay out of devious traps, fight off ever-increasing waves of enemies, and [b]encounter seven new, truly powerful bosses[/b] - Paragons. These are the legendary Heroes of the past, and they're ready for battle once more. Will you have the courage to face them?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/a7f44d19d888080cb03f33f65d7fa76a27b140b9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fight in style[/h2]
A new outfit awaits you in [i][b]Asterigos: Call of the Paragons[/b][/i]. Smite your enemies rocking this incredibly beautiful [b]Paragon Armor.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/1357ab036c5ede775821810243e6ebae3cc27f09.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Realm and Rewards[/h2]
Explore [b]Phantasma[/b], an inter-dimension that holds the power of the ascended. To get there, you need to pay a visit to the shrines that can be found across the City of Aphes. Phantasma is a dangerous place that only the strongest warriors can enter, so make sure to complete the main story and max your skills first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/9378e361def6a352974b15bf8169c563723d31a9.jpg[/img]

Complete the challenges to unlock new powerful upgrades to your weapons that Vulcane would be happy to modify for you when you visit her in The Shelter! A total of [b]twelve new weapons[/b] endowed with the power of the gods await you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/3b5551146c609a80794c70f0c8939602ee80136e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Update 1.06[/h2]
We’ll also have a [b]major free update available to all players[/b] that will introduce several cool new features, another batch of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and more! 

We’ll be sharing more news and details about [i][b]Asterigos: Call of the Paragons[/b][/i] and Update 1.06 in the coming weeks, so make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/MqErEDrf8Z]join our Discord server[/url] and follow us on Social media:

notes.title: Update 1.05 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello, warriors of the Northwind Legion!

We actively collect your feedback and forge updates for Asterigos: Curse of The Stars. Thank you so much for sharing your comments with us. We appreciate it!

Today we are pleased to release update 1.05, addressing various bugs, balance, and gameplay enhancements.

[h2]Controls settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improve the lock on target switching when using the mouse.(PC)
[*] You will now be able to change the button tooltip display to match the controllers from the PlayStation or Xbox. (PC)
[/list]
[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cliff climbing is now at a faster speed.
[*] Increase the speed of elevators.
[*] Journal pages now have the associated title.
[*] Teleportation UI now shows the count information about the mimic, teumess, and chests on the location.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/9f979b1223d4c339b76ef12d68cec3a6c16496ef.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Game+[/h2]
[list]
[*] Teleporting via conduits is unlocked from the start of NG+ and does not require to complete the mission, but does require to Activate the conduits.
[*] You can now craft all quest rewards with the NG+ 3rd round and beyond.
[*] Equipping the [b]Eye of the Abyss Amulet[/b] or [b]Calamity Ring[/b] will give a warning message.
[/list]
[h2]Perks and Skills[/h2]
[list]
[*] The short dash from the [b]Shield of Vengeance[/b] now goes toward enemies.
[*] Increased damage of [b]Aegis Whirlwind[/b].
[*] [b]Shieldbreaker[/b] will now also deal damage after breaking the enemy's defense.

notes.title: Update 1.04 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello, brave warriors.

It's been just under a month since the great gates to the legendary City of Aphes opened, and we're beyond excited for all the adventurers who have already come through them!

We actively collected all your feedback and suggestions and worked through them thoroughly. Thank you so much for sharing your feedback with us.

We’d also like to take a moment and ask you to please leave your review on Steam if you haven’t done so yet, that’d be greatly appreciated! 

[previewyoutube=DkDkLCgA1D4;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's what we've fixed in update 1.04.

[h3]Keybinding & controls settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added customizable key binding for both controller types, keyboard (PC only), and mouse (PC only). 
[*] You can now jump without hitting the dodge button while dashing/running.
[*] Joysticks controls can now be used in the full-screen interfaces.
[/list]
[h3]Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new camera modes in the System Preferences.
[*] Added camera distance adjustment bar in the System Preferences.
[/list]
[h3]QoL Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Opening the system menu now pauses the game.
[*] You will now always be re-spawned with salts filled to 5 at any conduit.
[*] You can now perform weapon techniques while dashing.
[*] The time required to skip a death scene has been reduced.
[*] You will not be attacked when looting the chest.
[*] Resting at the conduit or dying in the game will now automatically move the salve from the vault to your bag.
[*] You no longer lose stamina by dashing when not in combat. 
[*] Added the maximum number of looted chests for game records in the Archive.
[*] Reduced the number of attack counts you need to hit the magic-breakable items.
[*] Improved Hilda's on-hit animation and effects.
[*] Improved the enemy's on-hit effects.
[*] Hilda's hitbox size has been adjusted to fit the model boundaries better.
[*] The Battle Maiden outfit will now be account-wide. Once unlocked in the New Game + mode, you will be able to use it with any other saves of your game.
[*] Added some soft guidance towards main objectives by enhancing the lighting and placing more arrows and doodads.
[/list]
[h3]Perks & Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced stamina cost for the ‘Marathon Runner’ perk to make it more convenient.
[*] Increased the damage and effect of the ‘Slice and Dice’ for daggers.
[*] Increased attack speed of the staff perk ‘Rapid Fire’.
[*] Increased the detection range of bracelets with the 'Homing Mine' perk.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Roxane's applause for not killing any blacksmiths at Phalan Academy will be able to trigger  before the Trinity NIght event.
[*] The side quest of the cultist Narkis in the sewers of Arges Plaza will now be available when you find the Strange Key.
[*] Titanite no longer requires the Glimmer to be active in order to be picked up.
[*] Shaye will now continue to sell his special goods at Caelum Summit.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause game saving to fail.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause Hilda to use bracelets to morph weapons without an active talent.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hilda to take damage using the hammer's Super Armor state.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hilda to not be able to shoot faster with the ‘Rapid Fire’ staff perk.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hilda to gain AP when using multiple skills.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Hilda's animation to not play correctly when using the ‘Shield Boomerang’ skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bracelet perk ‘Homing Mine’, to not track the target correctly. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when encountering werewolves in Arges Bazaar. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the quest tooltip to not update when taking the alternate route in Phalan Academy.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the man-eater lion Mash to be unapproachable in Phalan Academy.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Temple of Mercy guard event to not reset correctly in the Sunken Outskirts.
[*] Fixed a bug that made it impossible to obtain the Odysseus dog tag after completing a side quest.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the mimic in the Arges Plaza sewer to respawn.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the stone to unintentionally block the way in the Arges Plaza sewer.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused destructible stones in the Glittering Deeps not to break in some situations.
[*] Fixed a bug causing Hilda to get stuck in the titan sealing device.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Kavouras boss to not spawn after the Trinity Night event.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Wassily's boss barrier not to seal completely. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some of the already looted bags to respawn without any interaction.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused trinkets not to be saved in the vault.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Pink Grape Earrings trinket to not work correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Eye of the Abyss Amulet trinket to not work correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Final Cinematic to glitch for some players.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from entering the 10th New Game+.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update and immediate development plans
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Firstly, we want to thank all the brave adventurers who have already made it into the legendary city of Aphes! We are eternally grateful for your support and the feedback you share with us across all channels.
We see and collect a lot of feedback and would now like to tell you about our immediate plans.

[h2]Ability to reassign the controls[/h2]
While the demo was available on Steam, we received a lot of feedback from players regarding the ability to reassign the controls. We actually started working on these customizations before the game's release. We’ll be prioritizing this task so you can re-assign the character controls in the next major update.

We want to ensure that the new keybinding system will be compatible with the current pre-sets and usable for both controller types and mouse + keyboard.

[h2]Item interactions[/h2]
We also received feedback that some players are getting stuck in a status where they cannot interact with the items. We are working to solve this issue to ensure players have a smoother experience.

[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Navigation clarity[/h3]
We see some places and locations are notably easier to get lost in, so we will be adding more hinting marks to ensure the routes are easier to navigate.

[h3]Game performance & combat experience[/h3]
We will continue to improve the game's overall performance to provide a smoother experience on different configurations. In addition, we plan to improve the combat system further so that players enjoy a more responsive and authentic combat.

Thank you very much for all your feedback! Please keep letting us know about bugs you encounter or suggestions you have [url=https://discord.gg/MqErEDrf8Z]in Discord[/url] or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1731070/discussions/]Steam forums[/url].

notes.title: The update for the demo is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/45c748b659e812e3c3e44ddd9303e30235a8bbda.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
 
First of all we’d like to say thank you for all the feedback and suggestions you provided us . This has been extremely helpful as we continue to work hard on improving the gaming experience for you.

Now let’s jump into the list of changes we have applied to the demo!

[h2]The Controls[/h2]
We hope to improve the “stiffness” and bring you an overall more enjoyable experience
[list]
[*] We've refined Hilda's actions and controls - she can now switch to sprint/dash state in a timely manner, and all her evasive actions will be properly executed if you have enough stamina points. 
[*] The stamina points will also now regenerate at a faster rate.
[*] Hilda can now recover quicker from being knocked down, reducing the uncomfortable feeling during the lost control of the character. 
[/list]
[h2]The Techniques of Weapons[/h2]
You can now familiarise yourself with the special techniques of each weapon in the weapons interface. We hope this will help you understand the special features of each weapon and what they are useful for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/e4c26512d4c6fc16c6c7127f37ae763e5bc90162.jpg[/img]

[h2]Input Mapping and Keybinding[/h2]
We heard you! We have immediately jumped into the development of this feature. It will take some time, but we promise it will be delivered to your hands in the near future. We understand your needs and what most players are used to, so we've changed the default gamepad input to the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/4081a9aebd9c42b97b8db83c6a4f908359bf286f.jpg[/img]

We've added another option so that you can link the 'sprint / dash' action to the left-hand joystick, as well as three more presets for you to choose from!

[h2]Resolution and Fullscreen[/h2]
[b]You can now run the game in full screen mode[/b], and the resolution will scale according to the resolution you choose, which should apply to most ultra wide screens too! Please share your feedback with us if you encounter any issues.

[h2]Bion, Vanguard of the Adherents[/h2]
Some of you may know him. Some of you may not. But he's back again! We realise that putting an invincible boss at the end of the demo is not the best solution. So in this case, we purposely added a checkpoint before the fight, polished up the encounter and made him defeatable in the demo so you can challenge him without too much trouble. 

Horn your skills and prepare to engage the Vanguard of the Adherents!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310629/d5eb6ac63847775aeb6768fb12cd07787cd386d7.png[/img]

[h2]Save files[/h2]
The game save data is now relocated to the following folder: [USER]/Saved Games/AcmeGs/AsterigosDEMO

[h2]And there’s more![/h2]
Bug fixes, camera optimization, enemy hitbox improvement, UI polishing, and more! We deeply appreciate your time and we hope you enjoy playing our game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731070/Asterigos_Curse_of_the_Stars/
